# Skeleton — sentinel v6

## Root claim

The bet is that owning the harness beats owning the models: compute and models commoditize, and value accrues to the orchestration layer that sits above them.

## Section claims

1. **§Commoditization** — the orchestration work is already largely commoditized at the model layer, so the durable value is not in the models themselves.
2. **§Recapture risk** — model owners cannot easily recapture the orchestration-layer value, because the harness is where switching costs and workflow lock-in accumulate.
3. **§Enclosure** — the enclosable part of orchestration is the harness: the escalation floor (the minimum task-autonomy level below which a task always escalates to a human) is invariant, and the harness is what owns it.
